description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
The ID of the security tunnel to delete.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 requests per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot delete-device-tunnel --tunnel-id d4098041-a560-000 --iot-instance-id iot-000-v6000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
